# Joe Monceballez — Homes In Corpus

> Joe Monceballez is a Corpus Christi, Texas Realtor (ValTex Realty, TREC License #0586828), active real estate investor, and contractor on his own renovation projects. 99 homes closed, 5.0 rating on Zillow (7 reviews). Bilingual English/Spanish. He lists homes, represents buyers at no cost to them, makes direct cash offers on houses as-is, and advises on pre-sale renovations. Service area: Corpus Christi, Portland, Calallen, Flour Bluff, Rockport, Ingleside, Robstown, Aransas Pass, and North Padre Island, TX. Call or text (361) 960-1779, or email joe@homesincorpus.com.

- [Buy a Home](https://homesincorpus.com/buy-a-home.html): Buyer representation — commission paid by seller
- [First-Time Buyers](https://homesincorpus.com/first-time-buyers.html): Lender guidance and step-by-step help
